name: tmux-pair
description: Spawn writer/reviewer agent pairs (or writer/reviewer/orchestrator triples) in fresh git worktrees, wired up via tmux. Each agent runs in its own pane and talks to its peer through a small Python helper. Includes a 5-gate workflow (Clarify, Reviewer-Readiness with rules-bootstrap loop, Plan-Check, Implementation Loop, Final-Verify) with scoped plugin-agents for the gates (reviewer-readiness-check + rules-bootstrap on Sonnet, gate-2-plan-check on Sonnet, gate-3-verifier on Haiku, gate-3-code-reviewer on Sonnet, RECON via built-in Explore on Haiku), shipped rules templates for 7 stacks (Rust, TypeScript, Python, Go, JavaScript, Java, generic), bundled companion skills (gepa for prompt-optimization, dg for adversarial code review), durable standards via claude --append-system-prompt-file + codex AGENTS.md, --effort flag in boot-command, and a model-aware compact-watcher with /compact [focus] support.
